sources.label: Wikipedia, "Epsilon Cancri"
sources.quote: Epsilon Cancri is a white-hued multiple star system in the zodiac constellation of Cancer.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 4.9 solar radii and 2.62 solar masses (FLAME) and 7,873 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
